title: Pennsylvania Health Officials Work to Stop Measles Outbreak
subtitle: As cases continue to rise across the state, experts warn that the disease could spread further into new communities.

summary.en: Pennsylvania is currently facing a serious measles outbreak that has already caused five deaths. With 943 confirmed cases across 39 counties, health officials are working to increase vaccination rates. Many cases are concentrated in areas without dedicated local health departments. Experts are also fighting against false information regarding vaccine safety. Local leaders are now calling for better infrastructure to help manage future health crises.
summary.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州目前正面臨嚴重的麻疹疫情，已造成五人死亡。全州三十九個郡累計九百四十三起確診病例，衛生官員正努力提高疫苗接種率。許多病例集中在缺乏專屬地方衛生部門的地區。專家們同時也在對抗關於疫苗安全性的錯誤資訊。地方領袖目前正呼籲改善基礎設施，以協助管理未來的健康危機。

paragraphs.en: Health officials in Pennsylvania are working hard to stop a growing measles outbreak that has now reached 943 confirmed cases across 39 counties. According to The Guardian Health, the situation has become increasingly urgent following the report of a fifth death linked to the disease. Experts warn that it is only a matter of time before the virus moves beyond the areas where it is currently most common.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州的衛生官員正致力於遏止日益嚴重的麻疹疫情，目前全州三十九個郡已累計九百四十三起確診病例。根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，隨著第五起與該疾病相關的死亡案例傳出，情勢已變得愈發緊迫。專家警告，病毒擴散至目前疫情較輕的地區，恐怕只是時間早晚的問題。

paragraphs.en: One of the biggest challenges in Pennsylvania is the lack of local health departments. Out of 67 counties, only seven have their own dedicated health offices. Lancaster county, which does not have its own department, currently has the highest number of cases at 381. Many of these cases are among Amish or similar religious groups who have historically low rates of the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine. The MMR vaccine is a medical treatment that helps the body fight off these three specific diseases.
paragraphs.zh: 賓夕法尼亞州面臨的最大挑戰之一，是缺乏地方衛生部門。在六十七個郡中，僅有七個郡設有專屬的衛生辦公室。目前疫情最嚴重的蘭開斯特郡（Lancaster County）並未設立自己的衛生部門，該郡確診數高達三百八十一例。許多病例集中在阿米什人（Amish）或類似的宗教團體中，這些群體向來對麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹（MMR）疫苗的接種率偏低。MMR疫苗是一種能協助人體對抗這三種特定疾病的醫療預防措施。

paragraphs.en: Jeanne Franklin, the director of the Chester county health department, explained that her team is preparing for the possibility that the virus will spread to other groups. Chester county currently has 83 cases, making it the third most affected area. Franklin noted that diseases do not respect county borders, and her team is operating under the assumption that the virus will continue to move into new communities. She emphasized that the goal is to prevent this, but they must be ready if it happens.
paragraphs.zh: 切斯特郡（Chester County）衛生部門負責人珍妮·富蘭克林（Jeanne Franklin）解釋，她的團隊正為病毒可能擴散至其他群體的情況做準備。切斯特郡目前有八十三起病例，是疫情第三嚴重的地區。富蘭克林指出，疾病不會受到行政區域邊界的限制，她的團隊正預設病毒將持續擴散至新的社區。她強調，雖然目標是防止疫情擴大，但他們必須做好應對最壞情況的準備。

paragraphs.en: Franklin also addressed the reasons behind low vaccination rates in some communities. She explained that many Amish people are not against vaccines because of strong beliefs, but rather because they are often unaware of them or do not seek out regular healthcare. She noted that these community members are often willing to talk and make decisions based on the health of their neighbors. However, health officials are also fighting against widespread false information. Some people have been told that vaccines are unsafe or contain harmful technology, which makes the job of health workers much harder.
paragraphs.zh: 富蘭克林也說明了部分社區疫苗接種率低的原因。她解釋，許多阿米什人並非因為強烈的信仰而反對疫苗，而是因為他們往往不了解疫苗，或是不常尋求常規醫療服務。她提到，這些社區成員通常願意溝通，並會基於鄰里的健康狀況做出決定。然而，衛生官員同時也在對抗廣泛流傳的錯誤資訊。有些人聽信了疫苗不安全或含有害技術的說法，這使得衛生工作者的任務變得更加艱鉅。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, the lack of local infrastructure makes the state's response more difficult. Because most counties do not have their own health departments, the state government must provide support to a very large area with a limited number of employees. Franklin argued that having a local department is a clear advantage because it allows them to use local staff who know the community and have existing relationships with local organizations. She believes that every county in Pennsylvania should have its own health department to better handle such outbreaks.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康版》報導，缺乏地方基礎設施使得該州的應對工作更加困難。由於大多數郡沒有自己的衛生部門，州政府必須以有限的人力支援廣大的區域。富蘭克林主張，擁有地方衛生部門是一項顯著優勢，因為這能讓他們運用熟悉社區且與在地組織已有合作關係的當地人員。她認為賓夕法尼亞州的每個郡都應設立自己的衛生部門，以更有效地處理此類疫情。

paragraphs.en: This outbreak is happening at a time when vaccine skepticism—a general doubt or lack of trust in the safety of vaccines—is growing across the United States. This trend is partly linked to the influence of public figures like Robert F. Kennedy Jr., who have questioned the safety of vaccines. This environment makes it difficult for doctors and nurses to convince people to get vaccinated. In response, health departments are working to set up community vaccination centers and improve their contact tracing, which is the process of finding people who were near an infected person to ensure they get medical help.
paragraphs.zh: 此次疫情爆發之際，正值美國各地對疫苗的懷疑態度——即對疫苗安全性普遍存疑或缺乏信任——日益高漲。這種趨勢部分與小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）等公眾人物的影響力有關，他們曾對疫苗的安全性提出質疑。這種環境使得醫師與護理師難以說服民眾接種疫苗。對此，衛生部門正努力設立社區疫苗接種中心，並加強接觸者追蹤工作，也就是找出曾與感染者接觸的人員，確保他們能獲得醫療協助。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, officials in Lancaster county are now trying to establish their own health department to better manage the current crisis and prepare for future health threats. As the state continues to monitor the situation, the focus remains on reaching those who are not vaccinated and providing clear, accurate information. The experience in Pennsylvania highlights the importance of having strong local health systems that can react quickly when a disease starts to spread. For now, health experts continue to urge residents to seek out medical advice and consider getting vaccinated to protect themselves and their neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，蘭開斯特郡的官員正試圖建立自己的衛生部門，以更好地管理當前的危機並為未來的健康威脅做好準備。隨著州政府持續監控疫情，重點仍放在接觸未接種疫苗的民眾，並提供清晰、準確的資訊。賓夕法尼亞州的經驗凸顯了擁有強大地方衛生系統的重要性，這能確保在疾病開始傳播時迅速做出反應。目前，衛生專家持續呼籲居民尋求醫療建議，並考慮接種疫苗，以保護自己與鄰居的健康。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To use energy or medicine to defend the body against a disease.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「打架」，這裡指身體對抗病毒。文中：The MMR vaccine is a medical treatment that helps the body fight off these three specific diseases.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be limited or stopped by something (used here to mean diseases do not stop at borders).
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「尊敬」，這裡指病毒不會因為行政區劃而停止傳播。文中：Franklin noted that diseases do not respect county borders, and her team is operating under the assumption that the virus will continue to move into new communities.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To look for something or someone, often with effort.
keyTerms.noteZh: 比一般的 seek 更強調「主動去尋找」的過程。文中：She explained that many Amish people are not against vaccines because of strong beliefs, but rather because they are often unaware of them or do not seek out regular healthcare.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason that Lancaster county is struggling significantly with the current measles outbreak?

options.A: It has the highest population density of all the counties in Pennsylvania.
options.B: It lacks a dedicated local health department to manage the crisis.
options.C: It is the only county where religious groups refuse all medical treatments.
options.D: Its residents have been more exposed to false information than other counties.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，文中明確指出 Lancaster 郡沒有自己的衛生部門，且該郡目前的確診病例數最高（381 例）。選項 A 文章未提及人口密度；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到 Amish 人群並非反對疫苗，而是缺乏資訊或未尋求醫療；選項 D 雖然提到假資訊，但並未說明 Lancaster 的假資訊比其他地方多，僅提到這是整體挑戰之一。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the lack of local health departments hinder the state's ability to control the measles?

options.A: Local departments are the only ones authorized to distribute the MMR vaccine.
options.B: The state government is intentionally withholding resources from counties without departments.
options.C: Without local offices, officials lack the established community trust and local knowledge needed for effective intervention.
options.D: Counties without health departments have higher rates of vaccine skepticism than those with them.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，Jeanne Franklin 強調擁有當地衛生部門的優勢在於能運用熟悉社區且與當地組織有既定關係的員工。這暗示了缺乏當地部門會導致缺乏這種信任基礎與在地連結，進而難以應對疫情。選項 A 文中未提及授權問題；選項 B 錯誤，文中僅提到資源有限，並非蓄意扣留；選項 D 在文中並無證據支持兩者有此直接因果關係。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'react' mean in the phrase 'react quickly when a disease starts to spread'?

options.A: To provide a medical response or take action in response to a stimulus.
options.B: To express strong disagreement with a new government policy.
options.C: To change the chemical composition of a vaccine to make it safer.
options.D: To wait for a period of time before making a final decision.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，react 指的是針對疾病傳播這一「刺激」採取相應的「行動」或「反應」。選項 B 與文意完全相反；選項 C 是化學或科學上的反應，與公共衛生應對無關；選項 D 錯誤，文中強調的是「快速」反應，而非等待。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania?

options.A: The measles outbreak is primarily caused by public figures like Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
options.B: The Amish community is solely responsible for the rapid spread of the measles virus.
options.C: Pennsylvania needs to immediately ban all religious groups that refuse vaccinations.
options.D: The outbreak highlights the critical need for strong, local health infrastructure to effectively manage public health crises.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章從疫情現況出發，探討了缺乏地方衛生部門的困難、疫苗猶豫的挑戰，並在結論中明確指出，賓州此次經驗凸顯了強大的地方衛生系統對於快速應對傳染病的重要性。選項 A 與 B 皆僅為文章提到的部分因素，而非主旨；選項 C 內容過於激進且文章中並未提出此建議。
